name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the single hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches 'at every moment the ball is out of the way, carry the key then or pick it up later'. It is a conditional rule with no added goal, so the rule-only warning is valid, and it is satisfiable: the agent can restore the ball in front of the door and re-pick the key before the box pickup.

texts: Whenever blocker_moved is true, has_door_key must be true then or later.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
